bios.Tirzepatide: A dual GIP and GLP-1 receptor agonist studied in metabolic and adipose-tissue research. Investigated for its role in glucose regulation, appetite signaling, and energy-balance pathways within laboratory models.
bios.CJC-1295 + Ipamorelin: A dual growth-hormone signaling blend. CJC-1295 (No DAC) is a GHRH analog that stimulates the pituitary, while Ipamorelin selectively activates the ghrelin receptor. Studied together for pulsatile GH release, IGF-1 pathways, and tissue-recovery research.
bios.MOTS-c: A mitochondrial-derived peptide studied for its role in cellular metabolism, energy utilization, and metabolic-regulation pathways. Of interest in longevity and mitochondrial-signaling research.
bios.GHK-Cu: A copper-binding tripeptide studied for its role in skin biology, collagen regulation, and extracellular-matrix maintenance. Widely investigated in regenerative and cosmetic research models.
bios.AHK-Cu: A copper-binding tripeptide (Alanine-Histidine-Lysine) studied in hair-follicle biology, cellular regeneration, and growth-factor signaling. Investigated for tissue remodeling and follicular-activity research.
bios.NAD+: Nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide, a coenzyme central to cellular energy metabolism. Studied for its role in mitochondrial function, DNA repair signaling, and longevity-related pathways.
bios.IGF-1 LR3: A long-acting analog of insulin-like growth factor 1. Studied for cellular growth, protein synthesis, and tissue-repair signaling pathways in laboratory research.
bios.TB-500: A synthetic version of Thymosin Beta-4 studied for its role in cellular migration, angiogenesis, and tissue-repair pathways. Widely investigated in recovery and connective-tissue research.
bios.KPV: A tripeptide fragment of alpha-MSH studied for its anti-inflammatory signaling and role in gut-barrier and immune-pathway research.
bios.ARA-290: Also known as Cibinetide, a synthetic erythropoietin-derived peptide studied for tissue-protective and anti-inflammatory signaling — without stimulating red-blood-cell production. Investigated in nerve-repair and cellular-recovery research.
bios.Tesamorelin: A synthetic growth-hormone-releasing hormone (GHRH) analog studied for its interaction with pituitary signaling and its role in metabolic and adipose-tissue research.
bios.Sermorelin Acetate: A GHRH analog studied for stimulating natural growth-hormone release through pituitary signaling. Investigated in endocrine and metabolic research models.
bios.Selank: A synthetic peptide studied for its role in anxiety-related signaling, cognitive pathways, and neuro-modulation research.
bios.SEMAX: A synthetic peptide derived from an ACTH fragment, studied for neuroprotective signaling, cognitive pathways, and BDNF-related research.
bios.Kisspeptin-10: A peptide studied for its role in reproductive-endocrine signaling and regulation of the hypothalamic-pituitary-gonadal axis in laboratory research.
bios.PT-141: Also known as Bremelanotide, a melanocortin-receptor agonist studied for its role in central-nervous-system signaling pathways in research models.
bios.HCG: Human chorionic gonadotropin, studied for its role in endocrine signaling and reproductive-pathway research.
bios.GLOW Blend: A recovery and skin-focused research blend combining BPC-157, GHK-Cu, and TB-500 — studied for tissue-repair, regenerative, and extracellular-matrix signaling pathways.
bios.Bacteriostatic Water: Sterile 0.9% benzyl-alcohol water used as a diluent for reconstituting lyophilized research compounds. Preservative formulation supports multi-use laboratory preparation under sterile technique.
bios.GLP3-R: A triple receptor agonist studied across the GIP, GLP-1, and glucagon receptor families. Investigated in metabolic research for glucose regulation, appetite signaling, and energy-expenditure pathways — the current apex of incretin research compounds.
bios.Cagrilintide: A long-acting amylin analog studied for its role in appetite regulation and metabolic signaling. Investigated on its own and alongside GLP-1 compounds in weight-management research models.
bios.BPC-157: Body Protection Compound-157, a synthetic peptide derived from a protein found in gastric juice. Studied extensively for tissue repair, angiogenesis, and anti-inflammatory signaling — popular in tendon, ligament, muscle, and gut-healing research.
bios.AOD-9604: A modified fragment of human growth hormone (residues 176–191) studied for fat metabolism and lipolytic signaling. Investigated for its ability to mimic GH's fat-burning effects without affecting blood sugar or growth pathways.
bios.5-Amino-1MQ: A small-molecule NNMT inhibitor studied for its role in cellular metabolism, NAD+ regulation, and adipocyte signaling. Investigated in metabolic and longevity research models.
bios.KLOW Blend: A comprehensive recovery and skin research blend combining KPV, BPC-157, GHK-Cu, and TB-500 — studied for tissue-repair, anti-inflammatory, and regenerative signaling pathways.
bios.Wolverine Blend: A recovery-focused research blend pairing BPC-157 and TB-500 — studied together for tissue repair, cellular migration, and connective-tissue regeneration pathways.
bios.SS-31: Also known as Elamipretide, a mitochondria-targeted peptide studied for its role in stabilizing cardiolipin on the inner mitochondrial membrane. Investigated for mitochondrial function, cellular energy production, and oxidative-stress pathways in longevity research.
bios.Epithalon: A synthetic tetrapeptide (Ala-Glu-Asp-Gly) studied for its role in telomerase activity, circadian regulation, and cellular-aging pathways. Widely investigated in longevity and pineal-signaling research.
bios.GHRP-6: A growth-hormone-releasing hexapeptide studied for its role in ghrelin-receptor activation and pulsatile GH release. Investigated for appetite signaling and tissue-recovery pathways in laboratory research.
bios.Ipamorelin: A selective growth-hormone secretagogue studied for its clean, targeted stimulation of GH release via the ghrelin receptor — without significantly affecting cortisol or prolactin. Investigated in recovery and GH-signaling research.
bios.HGH: Human growth hormone, studied for its central role in cellular growth, protein synthesis, metabolism, and tissue-repair signaling across a wide range of laboratory research models.
bios.Melanotan II: A synthetic melanocortin analog studied for its role in melanogenesis (pigmentation) and central melanocortin-receptor signaling. Investigated in pigmentation and appetite-pathway research.
bios.Acetic Acid Water: Dilute acetic acid solution used as a reconstitution diluent for peptides with poor solubility in bacteriostatic water. Supports laboratory preparation under sterile technique.
bios.Sharps Container: A puncture-resistant biohazard container for the safe disposal of used needles and syringes in a research setting. Supports secure, compliant sharps handling.
bios.Research Kit: An all-in-one research starter kit — includes a puncture-resistant sharps container, a research solution vial, insulin syringes, and 70% isopropyl alcohol prep pads. Everything needed for clean, compliant laboratory handling.
